sources.entry: Moonvalley - AI-powered video generation with advanced editing capabilities #freemium

summary.name: Moonvalley
summary.one_liner: Moonvalley is a research lab that offers Marey, an AI video generation model trained on licensed data for image-to-video and text-to-video creation.
use_cases: generate cinematic video from text prompts
animate a still image into video
transfer motion from a reference video to new subjects
create camera moves from a single image
draw object trajectories in generated video
summary.what_it_does: Marey generates image-to-video and text-to-video with cinematic detail, motion, and lighting. Pose transfer uses reference images or performance inputs to guide timing and apply motion to a subject. Camera control creates camera moves from a single image by converting the 2D scene into a 3D environment. Motion transfer pulls movement from a reference video onto new subjects, and trajectory control lets users draw paths for objects. The page says the model is trained on licensed, high-resolution cinematic footage and positions itself as commercially safe.
notable: Trained on licensed data, marketed as fully licensed and commercially safe
Camera control from a single image by converting 2D scenes to 3D
Trajectory control: draw object paths instead of prompting
Motion transfer from reference video to new subjects
caveats: Pricing tiers are not described on the page; the 'freemium' label comes from the directory listing
Platform availability beyond the website is not stated on the page
